X2_attribution.regime: shipped regime (run in parallel with X1); the arm that decides H14b is repeated under X1's regime only if H12 routes to B

arms.spectral_only: requires a model.pathways switch (spatial branch masked to 0 in train and eval) — small code change
arms.spatial_only: requires the same switch (spectral path and morphometrics masked) — small code change

X3_within_acquisition_8020.role: tier-1 number for D16; NOT a decision arm except for H15

hypotheses.H12a: X1 raises stratified macro-F1 by ≥ +0.05 over 0.712 (3-seed mean; ≈ 2.1 SE of the difference given sd 0.033)
hypotheses.H12b: X1 raises grouped macro-F1 by ≥ +0.02 (≥ 2σ, σ = 0.009) AND Δgrouped / Δstratified ≥ 0.37 (half the S09 transfer slope)
hypotheses.H13: X1 reaches clean training accuracy ≥ 0.95 on the D18 fixed training subset (the regime, not capacity, caused F35)
hypotheses.H14a: no_morph cross-session recall ≤ 0.07, i.e. at least half of the network's 0.152 is carried by the morphometrics
hypotheses.H14b: full − spectral_only grouped macro-F1 ≤ +0.02: the spatial pathway (79.6 % of parameters) adds nothing measurable
hypotheses.H15: X3 (80/20) − stratified 59 % (same regime) ≤ +0.03: training share is not what separates this project from the literature

decision_rule.H12a and H12b supported: model/training is the bottleneck for the score (D17 route B): next = architecture/training work, measured on all three D16 tiers
decision_rule.H12a supported, H12b rejected: in-distribution gains do not transfer: route A — stop capacity work; next = representation/data (FW-03, FW-18, FW-12)
decision_rule.H12a rejected: the regime is not the limit; read X2: if H14b supported, redesign the spatial-spectral pathway; else the representation binds (route A)
decision_rule.H14a supported: cross-session claims must be stated as shape-driven; reflectance has not been shown to give spectral cross-session transfer for the network

heldout_use: Each arm is scored once on val ∪ test. No arm, epoch, threshold or hyperparameter is chosen by its held-out score. A second round, if any, is a new frozen file naming what motivated it.
